=== non-interactive
$ orion-node setup --accept-discovered --yes

   ✓ Scanned                      found 7 things                                 3.1 s
   ✓ Accepted                     4 high-confidence · 1 already monitored
   ! Skipped                      nginx error.log needs a log key
   ✓ Applied                      no restart

  --dry-run prints the diff and stops. Log sources always need a key.

--- notes
NOTE Optional: Host metrics report from the first minute. Setup only adds monitors on top; nothing is blocked behind it.
NOTE Same list as the Console: Same groups, same confidence labels, same default ticks. High is pre-ticked; the rest is one tick away.
NOTE Pick and choose: Untick one, skip a kind, or press x to never suggest it again. Choices are saved to discovery: in the config file.
NOTE Propose, then apply: Review shows the exact diff first. Applying needs no restart; new monitors show waiting, then reporting.
NOTE Gated on a key: Log sources are suggested but never written without an ingest key, because logs can contain secrets.
NOTE For automation: --accept-discovered --yes takes the high-confidence set; --dry-run prints the diff. Connect is skipped when the host is already enrolled.
